const cv=document.getElementById('paper'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');let color='#ff595e',erase=false,down=false,last=null,stack=[],sticker=null;
function resizeCanvas(){let r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width)return;let d=window.devicePixelRatio||1;let prev=null;try{if(cv.width>0&&cv.height>0)prev=cv.toDataURL()}catch(e){}cv.width=Math.round(r.width*d);cv.height=Math.round(r.height*d);ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.fillRect(0,0,r.width,r.height);if(prev){let im=new Image();im.onload=()=>ctx.drawImage(im,0,0,r.width,r.height);im.src=prev}}
function snap(){try{stack.push(cv.toDataURL());if(stack.length>15)stack.shift()}catch(e){}}
function pos(e){let r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();cv.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);let p=pos(e);if(sticker){ctx.font='42px sans-serif';ctx.fillText(sticker,p.x,p.y);sticker=null;return}snap();down=true;last=p;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=erase?'white':color;ctx.fill()});
cv.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!down)return;e.preventDefault();let p=pos(e);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(last.x,last.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.strokeStyle=erase?'white':color;ctx.stroke();last=p});
['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'].forEach(n=>cv.addEventListener(n,()=>down=false));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{color=b.dataset.color;erase=false;document.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b))});

// Extra inkleurbare achtergronden: elk landschap staat achter de bestaande tekening.
const kleurAchtergronden = {
 'Vlinder':'tuin','Bloem':'tuin','Konijntjes in de bloemenwei':'tuin',
 'Vis':'zee','Dolfijnen in zee':'zee','Pinguïns op het ijs':'ijs',
 'Huis':'dorp','Aapjes in de jungle':'jungle','Leeuwen op de savanne':'savanne',
 'Olifanten bij de rivier':'rivier','Kikker aan de vijver':'vijver',
 'Zebra op de vlakte':'savanne','Beren in het bos':'bos','Vos in de herfst':'bos'
};
function kleurAchtergrond(soort){
 const r=(x,y,w,h)=>`<rect data-region x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="white"/>`;
 const circ=(x,y,rad)=>`<circle data-region cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${rad}" fill="white"/>`;
 const path=d=>`<path data-region d="${d}" fill="white"/>`;
 let parts=[];
 if(['zee','ijs','vijver','rivier'].includes(soort)){
   parts.push(path('M0 0 H320 V135 Q240 120 160 140 Q80 155 0 130Z'));
   parts.push(path('M0 135 Q80 155 160 140 Q240 120 320 135 V260 H0Z'));
   if(soort==='zee')parts.push(path('M5 220 Q25 205 45 220 T85 220 T125 220 T165 220 T205 220 T245 220 T285 220 T325 220'),circ(35,45,15),circ(270,35,19),path('M20 245 Q45 215 65 245Z'));
   if(soort==='ijs')parts.push(path('M0 210 L75 180 L145 218 L220 175 L320 215 V260 H0Z'),path('M20 60 L55 35 L90 60Z'),circ(255,45,18));
   if(soort==='vijver'||soort==='rivier')parts.push(path('M0 110 Q50 85 100 110 T210 110 T320 110 V135 H0Z'),path('M0 245 Q35 205 75 245Z'),path('M255 245 Q280 205 315 245Z'));
 }else{
   parts.push(path('M0 0 H320 V170 Q240 140 160 170 Q80 195 0 165Z'));
   parts.push(path('M0 165 Q80 195 160 170 Q240 140 320 170 V260 H0Z'));
   parts.push(circ(270,38,23));
   if(soort==='dorp')parts.push(path('M0 150 L55 95 L110 150Z'),path('M230 155 L275 110 L320 155Z'),r(12,150,76,95),r(260,155,50,85));
   if(['jungle','bos','tuin'].includes(soort)){
     parts.push(path('M10 205 L10 75 L-5 75 L25 22 L55 75 L40 75 L40 205Z'),path('M280 210 L280 90 L265 90 L295 30 L325 90 L310 90 L310 210Z'));
     parts.push(path('M0 235 Q20 205 40 235 T80 235 T120 235 T160 235 T200 235 T240 235 T280 235 T320 235 V260 H0Z'));
   }
   if(soort==='savanne')parts.push(path('M0 185 Q70 135 140 185 T320 175 V220 H0Z'),path('M275 210 V115 M240 135 Q275 95 310 135 Q280 160 240 135Z'));
 }
 // Losse kleine details maken de achtergrond leuker om zelf te kleuren.
 if(['tuin','bos','jungle','savanne','dorp'].includes(soort)){
  parts.push(circ(50,210,9),circ(50,210,3),circ(275,225,8),circ(275,225,3));
 }
 return `<g stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">${parts.join('')}</g>`;
}

// Extra natuurlijke details en inkleurbare vormen, zonder de eenvoudige bediening te veranderen.
function natuurDetails(name){
 const a=[];
 const shape=(d)=>`<path data-region d="${d}" fill="white"/>`;
 const line=(d)=>`<path d="${d}" fill="none"/>`;
 const circle=(x,y,r)=>`<circle data-region cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="white"/>`;
 const flower=(x,y)=>{a.push(circle(x,y,4));for(let j=0;j<5;j++){let q=j*Math.PI*2/5;a.push(`<ellipse data-region cx="${(x+10*Math.cos(q)).toFixed(1)}" cy="${(y+10*Math.sin(q)).toFixed(1)}" rx="5" ry="7" fill="white"/>`)}a.push(circle(x,y,4))};
 const grass=(x,y)=>a.push(line(`M${x} ${y} l-6 -10 M${x} ${y} l1 -14 M${x} ${y} l7 -9`));
 const water=['Vis','Dolfijnen in zee','Kikker aan de vijver','Olifanten bij de rivier'];
 if(water.includes(name)){
  for(const [x,y] of [[18,180],[45,220],[290,188],[265,235]])a.push(line(`M${x} ${y} q12 -7 24 0`));
  if(name==='Vis'||name==='Dolfijnen in zee')for(const [x,y,r] of [[30,70,9],[47,50,5],[285,65,7],[275,100,4],[42,110,4]])a.push(circle(x,y,r));
  if(name==='Kikker aan de vijver')a.push(shape('M15 225 Q45 196 77 225 Q50 246 15 225Z'),line('M20 220 L42 208 M42 208 L63 225'));
 }else{
  for(const [x,y] of [[18,238],[60,248],[252,249],[293,230]])grass(x,y);
  if(name!=='Huis') {flower(42,207);flower(277,207)}
  for(const [x,y] of [[35,47],[58,62],[245,75]])a.push(shape(`M${x} ${y} q9 -13 18 0 q-9 8 -18 0Z`));
 }
 if(name==='Vlinder'){
  a.push(circle(100,85,15),circle(220,85,15),circle(105,165,12),circle(215,165,12));
  a.push(line('M160 75 Q145 52 132 52 M160 75 Q175 52 188 52'));
 }
 if(name==='Vis'){
  a.push(line('M132 96 Q148 130 130 168'),line('M160 102 Q175 130 160 161'));
  for(const [x,y] of [[110,145],[137,127],[166,139]])a.push(shape(`M${x} ${y} q8 -9 16 0 q-8 8 -16 0Z`));
 }
 if(name==='Bloem'){
  for(const [x,y] of [[160,48],[205,80],[188,126],[132,126]])a.push(line(`M160 95 Q${x} ${y} ${x} ${y}`));
  flower(55,214);flower(270,217);
 }
 if(name==='Huis'){
  a.push(line('M55 125 L160 44 L264 125'),shape('M190 70 L190 38 L217 38 L217 92Z'));
  a.push(line('M100 137 V164 M90 150 H120 M147 158 V220 M135 184 H185'));
  a.push(shape('M10 250 Q50 230 90 250Z'),shape('M245 250 Q275 225 310 250Z'));
 }
 if(name==='Aapjes in de jungle'){

let fillColor='#ff595e',selectedTemplate=0, coloringTool='fill', activeBrushPath=null;let drawingLayer=null, eraserLayer=null;const templatesBox=document.getElementById('templates'),colorSvg=document.getElementById('colorSvg');
templates.forEach((t,i)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='template';b.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 320 320"><defs><clipPath id="colorCircle'+i+'"><circle cx="160" cy="160" r="124"/></clipPath></defs><circle cx="160" cy="160" r="124" fill="white"/><g clip-path="url(#colorCircle'+i+')" transform="translate(35.2 58.6) scale(.78)">'+t.svg+'</g></svg><span>'+tr(t.name)+'</span>';b.querySelector('span').dataset.translationKey=t.name;b.onclick=()=>{loadTemplate(i);document.getElementById('templatePicker').style.display='none';document.getElementById('colorWorkspace').style.display='block'};templatesBox.appendChild(b)});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-fill]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{fillColor=b.dataset.fill;document.querySelectorAll('[data-fill]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b))});
function loadTemplate(i){
 selectedTemplate=i;activeBrushPath=null;colorSvg.innerHTML=templates[i].svg;
 // Bewaar een afzonderlijke bovenste laag met gesloten, doorlopende contouren.
 // Zo kunnen ingekleurde vlakken nooit de grenslijnen van naburige vlakken bedekken.
 const outlines=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
 outlines.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');
 outlines.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
 colorSvg.querySelectorAll('[data-region]').forEach(el=>{
  if(el.tagName.toLowerCase()==='rect' && el.getAttribute('width')==='320' && el.getAttribute('height')==='260')return;
  if(templates[i].name && ['Hondje','Katje','Konijntje','Paard','Koe','Vos','Olifant','Zebra','Dolfijn','Uil'].includes(templates[i].name))return;
  const border=el.cloneNode(false);
  border.removeAttribute('data-region');border.setAttribute('fill','none');
  border.setAttribute('stroke','#090909');border.setAttribute('stroke-width', ['Vos in de herfst','Zebra op de vlakte'].includes(templates[i].name)?'4.2':'2.8');
  border.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');border.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin','round');
  border.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');outlines.appendChild(border);
 });
 setupDrawingLayers();
 colorSvg.querySelectorAll('[data-region]').forEach(el=>{el.style.cursor='pointer';el.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(coloringTool!=='fill')return;el.setAttribute('fill',fillColor);document.getElementById('colorstatus').textContent='Mooi gekleurd! Kies nog een stukje.'})});
 // Contouren komen als laatste: altijd zichtbaar, ook na tekenen en inkleuren.
 colorSvg.appendChild(outlines);
 document.getElementById('colorstatus').textContent=tr('Kleur de ')+tr(templates[i].name.toLowerCase())+tr(' in!');
}
// Keep hand-drawn strokes separate from the underlying colouring page.
// Eraser paths mask only brush marks; the picture outlines remain intact.
const svgNS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function setupDrawingLayers(){
 const defs=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'defs');
 const mask=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'mask');mask.id='kpBrushEraseMask';
 mask.setAttribute('maskUnits','userSpaceOnUse');mask.setAttribute('x','0');mask.setAttribute('y','0');mask.setAttribute('width','320');mask.setAttribute('height','260');
 const white=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'rect');white.setAttribute('width','320');white.setAttribute('height','260');white.setAttribute('fill','white');mask.appendChild(white);
 eraserLayer=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'g');mask.appendChild(eraserLayer);defs.appendChild(mask);colorSvg.appendChild(defs);
 drawingLayer=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'g');drawingLayer.setAttribute('mask','url(#kpBrushEraseMask)');drawingLayer.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');colorSvg.appendChild(drawingLayer);
}
const fillToolButton=document.getElementById('fillTool'),brushToolButton=document.getElementById('brushTool'),eraserToolButton=document.getElementById('eraserTool');
function setColoringTool(tool){coloringTool=tool;fillToolButton.classList.toggle('active',tool==='fill');brushToolButton.classList.toggle('active',tool==='brush');eraserToolButton.classList.toggle('active',tool==='eraser');colorSvg.style.cursor=tool==='fill'?'pointer':'crosshair'}
fillToolButton.onclick=()=>setColoringTool('fill');brushToolButton.onclick=()=>setColoringTool('brush');eraserToolButton.onclick=()=>setColoringTool('eraser');
function brushPoint(e){const p=colorSvg.createSVGPoint();p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;const matrix=colorSvg.getScreenCTM();if(!matrix)return null;const q=p.matrixTransform(matrix.inverse());return {x:Math.max(0,Math.min(320,q.x)),y:Math.max(0,Math.min(260,q.y))}}
colorSvg.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if((coloringTool!=='brush'&&coloringTool!=='eraser')||e.button>0)return;e.preventDefault();const q=brushPoint(e);if(!q)return;
 const path=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'path');path.setAttribute('d',`M${q.x.toFixed(1)} ${q.y.toFixed(1)} l0.01 0`);path.setAttribute('fill','none');path.setAttribute('stroke',coloringTool==='eraser'?'black':fillColor);path.setAttribute('stroke-width',Number(document.getElementById('brushSize').value)*(coloringTool==='eraser'?1.7:1));path.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');path.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin','round');path.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');
 (coloringTool==='eraser'?eraserLayer:drawingLayer).appendChild(path);activeBrushPath={id:e.pointerId,path};colorSvg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
});
colorSvg.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!activeBrushPath||activeBrushPath.id!==e.pointerId)return;e.preventDefault();const q=brushPoint(e);if(q)activeBrushPath.path.setAttribute('d',activeBrushPath.path.getAttribute('d')+` L${q.x.toFixed(1)} ${q.y.toFixed(1)}`)});
function stopColorBrush(e){if(activeBrushPath&&activeBrushPath.id===e.pointerId)activeBrushPath=null}

function drawScene(index){sc.clearRect(0,0,560,360);const im=sceneImages[index];if(im&&im.complete&&im.naturalWidth){sc.drawImage(im,0,0,560,360);sourceCanvas.getContext('2d').clearRect(0,0,560,360);sourceCanvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,560,360)}else{sc.fillStyle='#d8f3ff';sc.fillRect(0,0,560,360);sc.fillStyle='#176b9a';sc.font='bold 28px system-ui';sc.textAlign='center';sc.fillText('Even laden…',280,180)}}

function startSelectedPuzzle(i){updatePuzzlePreviews(i);selectedScene=i;document.getElementById('puzzleChooser').style.display='none';document.getElementById('puzzlePlay').style.display='none';document.getElementById('puzzleSizeChooser').style.display='block';document.getElementById('sizeTitle').textContent=tr('Kies het aantal stukjes')}

function edgePath(ctx,x,y,w,h,edges){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w*.32,y);if(edges.top===1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.34,y-18,x+w*.4,y-21,x+w*.5,y-21);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.6,y-21,x+w*.66,y-18,x+w*.68,y)}else if(edges.top===-1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.34,y+18,x+w*.4,y+21,x+w*.5,y+21);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.6,y+21,x+w*.66,y+18,x+w*.68,y)}ctx.lineTo(x+w,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h*.32);if(edges.right===1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w+18,y+h*.34,x+w+21,y+h*.4,x+w+21,y+h*.5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w+21,y+h*.6,x+w+18,y+h*.66,x+w,y+h*.68)}else if(edges.right===-1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w-18,y+h*.34,x+w-21,y+h*.4,x+w-21,y+h*.5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w-21,y+h*.6,x+w-18,y+h*.66,x+w,y+h*.68)}ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x+w*.68,y+h);if(edges.bottom===1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.66,y+h+18,x+w*.6,y+h+21,x+w*.5,y+h+21);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.4,y+h+21,x+w*.34,y+h+18,x+w*.32,y+h)}else if(edges.bottom===-1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.66,y+h-18,x+w*.6,y+h-21,x+w*.5,y+h-21);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+w*.4,y+h-21,x+w*.34,y+h-18,x+w*.32,y+h)}ctx.lineTo(x,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x,y+h*.68);if(edges.left===1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x-18,y+h*.66,x-21,y+h*.6,x-21,y+h*.5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x-21,y+h*.4,x-18,y+h*.34,x,y+h*.32)}else if(edges.left===-1){ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+18,y+h*.66,x+21,y+h*.6,x+21,y+h*.5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+21,y+h*.4,x+18,y+h*.34,x,y+h*.32)}ctx.closePath()}
function makePuzzle(){drawScene(selectedScene);let cols=Math.sqrt(pieceCount),rows=cols,cw=560/cols,ch=360/rows;board.width=560;board.height=360;pieces=[];solved=0;tray.innerHTML='';let vert=[],hor=[];for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){hor[r]=[];for(let c=0;c<cols;c++)hor[r][c]=r===0?0:(Math.random()<.5?1:-1)}for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){vert[r]=[];for(let c=0;c<=cols;c++)vert[r][c]=(c===0||c===cols)?0:(Math.random()<.5?1:-1)}bctx.clearRect(0,0,560,360);bctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas,0,0);bctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.70)';bctx.fillRect(0,0,560,360);for(let r=0;r<rows;r++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){let ed={top:r===0?0:-hor[r][c],right:vert[r][c+1],bottom:r===rows-1?0:hor[r+1][c],left:-vert[r][c]};let x=c*cw,y=r*ch;bctx.save();edgePath(bctx,x,y,cw,ch,ed);bctx.strokeStyle='#4f8c9b';bctx.lineWidth=3;bctx.stroke();bctx.restore();let can=document.createElement('canvas');const pad=25,scale=2;can.width=Math.round((cw+pad*2)*scale);can.height=Math.round((ch+pad*2)*scale);let cx=can.getContext('2d');cx.scale(scale,scale);cx.translate(pad,pad);edgePath(cx,0,0,cw,ch,ed);cx.save();cx.clip();cx.drawImage(sourceCanvas,-x,-y);cx.restore();cx.save();edgePath(cx,0,0,cw,ch,ed);cx.strokeStyle='#25465c';cx.lineWidth=3.5;cx.lineJoin='round';cx.stroke();cx.restore();pieces.push({id:r*cols+c,correctX:x,correctY:y,canvas:can,placed:false,ed})}pieces.sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);pieces.forEach(p=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='piece';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Puzzelstukje');let mini=document.createElement('canvas');mini.width=p.canvas.width;mini.height=p.canvas.height;mini.getContext('2d').drawImage(p.canvas,0,0);b.appendChild(mini);b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>startDrag(e,p,b));tray.appendChild(b);p.button=b});document.getElementById('puzzlestatus').textContent=tr('Sleep de stukjes naar de juiste plek. Nog ')+pieceCount+tr(' te gaan!')}
function startDrag(e,p,el){if(p.placed)return;e.preventDefault();let rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();dragging={p,el,ox:e.clientX-rect.left,oy:e.clientY-rect.top};el.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);el.style.position='fixed';el.style.zIndex=99;el.style.width=rect.width+'px';el.style.height=rect.height+'px';el.style.background='transparent';el.style.boxShadow='none';el.style.border='0';el.style.outline='none';moveDrag(e);el.addEventListener('pointermove',moveDrag);el.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag,{once:true});el.addEventListener('pointercancel',endDrag,{once:true});function moveDrag(ev){if(!dragging||dragging.el!==el)return;el.style.left=(ev.clientX-dragging.ox)+'px';el.style.top=(ev.clientY-dragging.oy)+'px'}function endDrag(ev){el.removeEventListener('pointermove',moveDrag);if(!dragging||dragging.el!==el)return;let br=board.getBoundingClientRect(),sx=br.width/560,sy=br.height/360,localX=(ev.clientX-br.left)/sx,localY=(ev.clientY-br.top)/sy,cw=560/Math.sqrt(pieceCount),ch=360/Math.sqrt(pieceCount);let good=Math.abs(localX-(p.correctX+cw/2))<cw*.72&&Math.abs(localY-(p.correctY+ch/2))<ch*.72;if(good){p.placed=true;solved++;el.remove();bctx.save();edgePath(bctx,p.correctX,p.correctY,cw,ch,p.ed);bctx.clip();bctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas,0,0);bctx.restore();bctx.save();edgePath(bctx,p.correctX,p.correctY,cw,ch,p.ed);bctx.strokeStyle='#fff';bctx.lineWidth=3;bctx.stroke();bctx.restore();document.getElementById('puzzlestatus').textContent=solved===pieceCount?'🎉 Hoera! De puzzel is af! Goed gedaan!':tr('Goed zo! Nog ')+(pieceCount-solved)+tr(' stukjes.');if(solved===pieceCount){bctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas,0,0);showBravo("Je puzzel is helemaal af! 🧩")}}else{el.style.position='';el.style.left='';el.style.top='';el.style.width='';el.style.height='';el.style.zIndex='';el.style.background='';el.style.boxShadow='';el.style.border='';el.style.outline='';document.getElementById('puzzlestatus').textContent='Bijna! Probeer een ander plekje 🙂'}dragging=null}}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-pieces]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{pieceCount=+b.dataset.pieces;document.querySelectorAll('[data-pieces]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));document.getElementById('puzzleSizeChooser').style.display='none';document.getElementById('puzzlePlay').style.display='block';document.getElementById('puzzleTitle').textContent=scenes[selectedScene].emoji+' '+tr(scenes[selectedScene].name);document.getElementById('puzzleHint').textContent=tr('Leg de stukjes bij elkaar: ')+tr(scenes[selectedScene].name);makePuzzle()});document.getElementById('shufflePuzzle').onclick=makePuzzle;

function addGrayRoomObjects(scene){
 const files=grayMaskFiles[currentRoom]||{};
 Object.entries(files).forEach(([name,file])=>{
  const layer=document.createElement('img');
  layer.src=kpImage('kamerbeelden/grijsmaskers/'+file);

  layer.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;object-fit:fill;z-index:1;transition:opacity .45s ease';
  scene.appendChild(layer);

}

}

function placeRoomItem(itemName,targetName,target){
 if(itemName!==targetName){document.getElementById('roomstatus').textContent=tr('Probeer een andere plaats!');return}
 if(roomDone.has(itemName))return;
 const item=roomData[currentRoom].items.find(x=>x[1]===itemName);
 if(!item)return;
 roomDone.add(itemName);
 revealRoomObject(itemName);
 target.classList.add('filled');
 target.innerHTML='';
 
 // Leave the original illustrated object visible instead of drawing a mismatched emoji or oversized photo.
 target.style.background='transparent';target.style.border='none';target.style.boxShadow='none';
 target.setAttribute('aria-label',tr(targetName)+' '+tr('correct geplaatst'));
 document.querySelectorAll('.room-item').forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.name===itemName){b.style.visibility='hidden';b.style.pointerEvents='none';b.draggable=false}});
 document.getElementById('roomstatus').textContent=roomDone.size===roomData[currentRoom].items.length?tr('De kamer is klaar! Goed gedaan!'):tr('Goed gedaan!');if(roomDone.size===roomData[currentRoom].items.length)showBravo('Alle voorwerpen staan goed! 🏡');
}
function findRoomDropTarget(x,y,name,dragRect){
 const scene=document.getElementById('cartoonRoom');
 const target=[...scene.querySelectorAll('.room-furniture')].find(t=>t.dataset.name===name&&!roomDone.has(name));
 if(!target)return null;
 const sr=scene.getBoundingClientRect(),r=target.getBoundingClientRect();
 // Woonkamer: de volledige getekende contour is geldig, ook bij loslaten aan de rand.
 // Gebruik de werkelijk weergegeven kamerafmetingen (niet de scherm- of vingerafmetingen).
 const margin=Math.max(24,Math.min(68,sr.width*.105));
 const inside=(px,py)=>px>=r.left-margin&&px<=r.right+margin&&py>=r.top-margin&&py<=r.bottom+margin;
 if(inside(x,y))return target;
 if(dragRect){
  const cx=(dragRect.left+dragRect.right)/2,cy=(dragRect.top+dragRect.bottom)/2;
  if(inside(cx,cy))return target;
  const ox=Math.max(0,Math.min(r.right+margin,dragRect.right)-Math.max(r.left-margin,dragRect.left));
  const oy=Math.max(0,Math.min(r.bottom+margin,dragRect.bottom)-Math.max(r.top-margin,dragRect.top));
  const overlap=ox*oy;
  if(overlap>=Math.min(dragRect.width*dragRect.height*.16,r.width*r.height*.22))return target;
 }
 return null;
}
// Ook op lege delen van de kamer werken drops, niet alleen op de exacte DOM-zone.
function acceptRoomDrop(name,x,y,rect){
 const target=findRoomDropTarget(x,y,name,rect);
 if(target){placeRoomItem(name,target.dataset.name,target);return true}
 document.getElementById('roomstatus').textContent=tr('Sleep het voorwerp naar de bijpassende gestippelde contour.');
 return false;
}

function startRoomTouch(e,b,name){
 if(e.button!==undefined&&e.button!==0)return;
 e.preventDefault();
 const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(),ghost=b.cloneNode(true);
 ghost.style.cssText=`position:fixed;left:${r.left}px;top:${r.top}px;width:${r.width}px;height:${r.height}px;z-index:1000;opacity:.92;pointer-events:none;transform:none;box-shadow:0 4px 15px #0003;border:2px solid #2196f3`;
 document.body.appendChild(ghost);
 let lastX=e.clientX,lastY=e.clientY,finished=false;
 const dx=e.clientX-r.left,dy=e.clientY-r.top;
 try{b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
 function move(ev){
  if(ev.pointerId!==e.pointerId)return;
  ev.preventDefault();lastX=ev.clientX;lastY=ev.clientY;
  ghost.style.left=(lastX-dx)+'px';ghost.style.top=(lastY-dy)+'px';
 }
 function cleanup(){b.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);b.removeEventListener('pointerup',end);b.removeEventListener('pointercancel',cancel);b.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture',cancel);ghost.remove();}
 function end(ev){if(finished||ev.pointerId!==e.pointerId)return;finished=true;move(ev);const rect=ghost.getBoundingClientRect();cleanup();acceptRoomDrop(name,lastX,lastY,rect);}
 function cancel(){if(finished)return;finished=true;cleanup();}
 b.addEventListener('pointermove',move);
 b.addEventListener('pointerup',end);
 b.addEventListener('pointercancel',cancel);
 b.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',cancel);
}

function shapedBalloon(item){
 const [name,color,symbol]=item;
 const ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
 const svg=document.createElementNS(ns,'svg');svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 100 110');svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.classList.add('shaped-balloon-svg');
 const add=(tag,attrs)=>{const el=document.createElementNS(ns,tag);for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(attrs))el.setAttribute(k,v);svg.appendChild(el);return el};
 // Zachte, bolle folieballonvormen. De rechthoek staat rechtop en is duidelijk smaller.
 const shapePaths={
 '●':'M50 8 C72 8 91 25 91 49 C91 72 73 91 50 91 C27 91 9 72 9 49 C9 25 28 8 50 8 Z',
 '▲':'M50 7 Q56 7 61 17 L91 72 Q101 91 82 91 L18 91 Q-1 91 9 72 L39 17 Q44 7 50 7 Z',
 '■':'M19 9 Q9 9 9 20 V79 Q9 91 21 91 H79 Q91 91 91 79 V21 Q91 9 79 9 Z',
 '▭':'M37 5 H63 Q74 5 74 17 V81 Q74 93 63 93 H37 Q26 93 26 81 V17 Q26 5 37 5 Z',
 '⬟':'M50 6 Q55 6 60 10 L89 32 Q96 37 94 46 L83 82 Q80 92 70 92 H30 Q20 92 17 82 L6 46 Q4 37 11 32 L40 10 Q45 6 50 6 Z'};
 if(mode==='numbers'){
   // Dikke, ronde opblaascijfers met een zachte rand en glans.
   const outline=add('text',{x:'50',y:'81','text-anchor':'middle','font-family':'Arial Rounded MT Bold, Arial, sans-serif','font-size':'88','font-weight':'900',fill:color,stroke:color,'stroke-width':'17','stroke-linejoin':'round','stroke-linecap':'round','paint-order':'stroke fill'});outline.textContent=symbol;
   const rim=add('text',{x:'50',y:'81','text-anchor':'middle','font-family':'Arial Rounded MT Bold, Arial, sans-serif','font-size':'88','font-weight':'900',fill:'none',stroke:'#ffffff','stroke-width':'2.5','stroke-linejoin':'round',opacity:'.65'});rim.textContent=symbol;
   const shine=add('text',{x:'46',y:'77','text-anchor':'middle','font-family':'Arial Rounded MT Bold, Arial, sans-serif','font-size':'88','font-weight':'900',fill:'none',stroke:'#ffffff','stroke-width':'4','stroke-linejoin':'round',opacity:'.28'});shine.textContent=symbol;
 }else if(mode==='shapes'){
   add('path',{d:shapePaths[symbol],fill:color,stroke:'#ffffff','stroke-width':'2.5','stroke-linejoin':'round'});
   // Lichtreflectie en een gebogen glans geven de vormen een opgeblazen uitstraling.
   const glint=symbol==='▭'?{cx:'39',cy:'27',rx:'5',ry:'12'}:{cx:'31',cy:'27',rx:'7',ry:'13'};
   add('ellipse',{...glint,fill:'#ffffff',opacity:'.42',transform:`rotate(22 ${glint.cx} ${glint.cy})`});
   add('path',{d:symbol==='▭'?'M33 46 Q30 62 34 76':'M18 46 Q15 63 26 74',fill:'none',stroke:'#ffffff','stroke-width':'3','stroke-linecap':'round',opacity:'.19'});
 }else if(mode==='animals'){
    // Dieren als opblaasbare hoofdballonnen, met oren en snuit in plaats van emoji.
    const part=(tag,attrs)=>add(tag,attrs);
    const ellipse=(cx,cy,rx,ry,fill,extra={})=>part('ellipse',{cx,cy,rx,ry,fill,...extra});
    const circle=(cx,cy,r,fill,extra={})=>part('circle',{cx,cy,r,fill,...extra});
    const path=(d,fill,extra={})=>part('path',{d,fill,...extra});
    const eye=(x,y)=>{ellipse(x,y,4.2,5.3,'#293144');circle(x-1.2,y-1.8,1.3,'#ffffff')};
    const balloonEdge={stroke:'#ffffff','stroke-width':'2.4','stroke-linejoin':'round'};
    if(name==='leeuw'){
      circle(50,51,44,'#d88a32',balloonEdge);
      for(let j=0;j<10;j++){const a=j*Math.PI/5;circle(50+37*Math.cos(a),51+36*Math.sin(a),12,'#c97928')}
      circle(50,50,32,'#ffd77b',balloonEdge);ellipse(50,65,19,14,'#ffe9ac');eye(38,47);eye(62,47);
      path('M45 60 Q50 56 55 60 L50 66 Z','#71422f');path('M50 66 Q44 73 39 68 M50 66 Q56 73 61 68','none',{stroke:'#71422f','stroke-width':'2.4','stroke-linecap':'round'});
    }else if(name==='panda'){
      circle(26,24,15,'#293344');circle(74,24,15,'#293344');
      ellipse(50,54,40,41,'#fff9f2',balloonEdge);ellipse(34,51,12,17,'#323b4d',{transform:'rotate(17 34 51)'});ellipse(66,51,12,17,'#323b4d',{transform:'rotate(-17 66 51)'});
      eye(35,52);eye(65,52);ellipse(50,71,12,9,'#ffffff');path('M44 67 Q50 63 56 67 L50 73 Z','#293344');
      path('M45 76 Q50 81 55 76','none',{stroke:'#293344','stroke-width':'2.4','stroke-linecap':'round'});
    }else if(name==='olifant'){
      ellipse(18,55,17,26,'#8ebde1',balloonEdge);ellipse(82,55,17,26,'#8ebde1',balloonEdge);
      ellipse(50,49,33,39,'#a8d5f0',balloonEdge);eye(38,49);eye(62,49);
      path('M42 62 Q42 53 50 54 Q58 53 58 62 L58 83 Q58 95 47 94 Q42 92 43 87 L46 84 Q50 89 51 83 L51 65 Z','#a8d5f0',{stroke:'#78a9cf','stroke-width':'2.2','stroke-linejoin':'round'});
      ellipse(22,56,7,14,'#e5b6cf');ellipse(78,56,7,14,'#e5b6cf');
    }else if(name==='giraf'){
      path('M29 33 L26 7 Q26 3 32 3 L39 30 Z','#d69b4b');path('M61 30 L68 3 Q74 3 74 8 L71 34 Z','#d69b4b');
      ellipse(27,18,9,13,'#e5ae59',{transform:'rotate(-28 27 18)'});ellipse(73,18,9,13,'#e5ae59',{transform:'rotate(28 73 18)'});
      ellipse(50,53,34,40,'#ffd780',balloonEdge);
      circle(33,35,7,'#c78d45');circle(70,39,6,'#c78d45');circle(29,69,6,'#c78d45');
      eye(39,51);eye(61,51);ellipse(50,72,21,14,'#f3b76d');ellipse(42,72,2.5,3.5,'#a36d43');ellipse(58,72,2.5,3.5,'#a36d43');
      path('M45 81 Q50 85 55 81','none',{stroke:'#98673c','stroke-width':'2','stroke-linecap':'round'});
    }else if(name==='zebra'){
      path('M36 23 L29 4 Q25 0 21 7 L21 37 Z','#f8f8f8',{stroke:'#455064','stroke-width':'2'});
      path('M64 23 L71 4 Q75 0 79 7 L79 37 Z','#f8f8f8',{stroke:'#455064','stroke-width':'2'});
      ellipse(50,52,36,42,'#f7f8fa',balloonEdge);
      path('M32 14 L45 35 L37 45 L21 26 Z','#384253');path('M68 14 L55 35 L63 45 L79 26 Z','#384253');
      path('M46 11 L51 34 L58 12 Z','#384253');path('M20 57 L35 63 L28 75 Z','#384253');path('M80 57 L65 63 L72 75 Z','#384253');
      eye(38,53);eye(62,53);ellipse(50,74,20,15,'#dce1e9');ellipse(43,74,3,3.5,'#485163');ellipse(57,74,3,3.5,'#485163');
      path('M45 83 Q50 86 55 83','none',{stroke:'#485163','stroke-width':'2'});
    }
    // Folieachtige reflecties maken ook de dieren duidelijk ballonvormig.
    ellipse(29,31,6,14,'#ffffff',{opacity:'.35',transform:'rotate(25 29 31)'});
 }else return null;
 if(mode==='numbers')add('ellipse',{cx:'31',cy:'26',rx:'7',ry:'13',fill:'#ffffff',opacity:'.48',transform:'rotate(25 31 26)'});
 add('path',{d:'M46 91 L50 99 L54 91 Z',fill:color});
 return svg;
}

 if(mode==='colors'){body.textContent='';return}
 body.classList.add('balloon-shaped');body.replaceChildren(shapedBalloon(item));
}

function renderBalloonChoiceBunches(){
 const ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
 document.querySelectorAll('.balloon-choices button[data-balloon-mode]').forEach(button=>{
  const kind=button.dataset.balloonMode;
  const old=button.querySelector('.balloon-choice-art');
  if(!old)return;
  const art=document.createElementNS(ns,'svg');
  art.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 210 164');art.setAttribute('class','balloon-choice-art');art.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  const positions=[{x:19,y:24,scale:.76},{x:112,y:25,scale:.76},{x:65,y:6,scale:.86}];
  // De touwtjes zijn strak en komen allemaal op hetzelfde punt samen.
  const knots=[[57,97],[150,98],[108,88]];
  knots.forEach(([x,y])=>{
   const line=document.createElementNS(ns,'path');line.setAttribute('d',`M${x} ${y} L105 151`);
   line.setAttribute('stroke','#82778e');line.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');line.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');line.setAttribute('fill','none');art.appendChild(line);
  });
  const previousMode=mode;mode=kind;
  [0,1,2].forEach(index=>{
   const item=data[kind][index];const pos=positions[index];
   const outer=document.createElementNS(ns,'g');outer.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${pos.x} ${pos.y}) scale(${pos.scale})`);
   let graphic;
   if(kind==='colors'){
    graphic=document.createElementNS(ns,'svg');graphic.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 100 110');graphic.setAttribute('width','100');graphic.setAttribute('height','110');
    const body=document.createElementNS(ns,'path');body.setAttribute('d','M50 7 C76 7 91 28 91 52 C91 75 73 92 50 92 C27 92 9 75 9 52 C9 28 24 7 50 7 Z');body.setAttribute('fill',item[1]);body.setAttribute('stroke','#ffffff');body.setAttribute('stroke-width','2.5');graphic.appendChild(body);
    const shine=document.createElementNS(ns,'ellipse');shine.setAttribute('cx','30');shine.setAttribute('cy','32');shine.setAttribute('rx','7');shine.setAttribute('ry','15');shine.setAttribute('transform','rotate(25 30 32)');shine.setAttribute('fill','#fff');shine.setAttribute('opacity','.5');graphic.appendChild(shine);
    const knot=document.createElementNS(ns,'path');knot.setAttribute('d','M45 92 L50 100 L55 92 Z');knot.setAttribute('fill',item[1]);graphic.appendChild(knot);
   }else graphic=shapedBalloon(item);
   graphic.setAttribute('width','100');graphic.setAttribute('height','110');outer.appendChild(graphic);art.appendChild(outer);
  });mode=previousMode;
  const knot=document.createElementNS(ns,'circle');knot.setAttribute('cx','105');knot.setAttribute('cy','151');knot.setAttribute('r','3.5');knot.setAttribute('fill','#82778e');art.appendChild(knot);
  old.replaceWith(art);
 });
}

(function () {
  const prefix = /^(?:\s*[\p{Extended_Pictographic}\p{Emoji_Presentation}\uFE0F\u200D\u20E3]+\s*)+/u;
  function cleanHeading(heading) {
    for (const node of heading.childNodes) {
      if (node.nodeType === 3 && node.textContent.trim()) {
        const cleaned = node.textContent.replace(prefix, '').trimStart();
        if (cleaned !== node.textContent) node.textContent = cleaned;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  function init() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.page:not(#home) h2').forEach(heading => {
      cleanHeading(heading);
      new MutationObserver(() => cleanHeading(heading)).observe(heading, {childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>

<script id="kp-transparent-background-parent-v3">
(function () {
  function fixHabitatBackground() {
    var frame = document.getElementById('kpEightFrame');
    if (!frame) return;
    var doc;
    try { doc = frame.contentDocument; } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!doc) return;
    var game = doc.querySelector('#game');
    var stage = doc.querySelector('#game .stage');
    [game, stage].forEach(function (element) {
      if (!element) return;
      if (element.style.getPropertyValue('background') !== 'transparent' ||
          element.style.getPropertyPriority('background') !== 'important') {
        element.style.setProperty('background', 'transparent', 'important');
      }
    });
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', fixHabitatBackground);
  setInterval(fixHabitatBackground, 300);
})();
</script>

</style><script id="kp-demo-native-drag-script">
(function(){
  // Eigen pointer-sleepfunctie binnen de gewone tekenpagina-layout, zonder habitat-iframe.
  const ids=['habitatsDemoFarm','habitatsDemoZoo','habitatsDemoOcean'];
  ids.forEach(id=>{
    const page=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!page)return;
    const scene=page.querySelector('.kp-demo-farm-image,.kp-demo-image-scene');
    const tray=page.querySelector('.kp-demo-farm-animals,.kp-demo-image-animals');
    if(!scene||!tray)return;
    let drag=null;
    // Bij het verlaten van de spelpagina alle dieren terug in hun oorspronkelijke rij zetten.
    let wasVisible=page.classList.contains('show');
    new MutationObserver(()=>{
      const visible=page.classList.contains('show');
      if(wasVisible&&!visible){
        if(drag){drag.ghost.remove();drag=null;window.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',finish);window.removeEventListener('pointercancel',cancel)}
        scene.querySelectorAll('.kp-demo-placed-animal').forEach(img=>img.remove());
        tray.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img=>img.style.visibility='');
      }
      wasVisible=visible;
    }).observe(page,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
    function move(e){
      if(!drag||e.pointerId!==drag.pointerId)return;
      drag.ghost.style.left=e.clientX+'px';
      drag.ghost.style.top=e.clientY+'px';
    }
    function finish(e){
      if(!drag||e.pointerId!==drag.pointerId)return;
      const d=drag;drag=null;
      d.ghost.remove();
      const r=scene.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(e.clientX>=r.left&&e.clientX<=r.right&&e.clientY>=r.top&&e.clientY<=r.bottom){
        const animal=d.placed||d.original.cloneNode(true);
        animal.classList.add('kp-demo-placed-animal');
        animal.style.left=(100*(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)+'%';
        animal.style.top=(100*(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)+'%';
        animal.draggable=false;
        if(!d.placed){scene.appendChild(animal);d.original.style.visibility='hidden'}
      }
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup',finish);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel',cancel);
    }
    function cancel(){if(!drag)return;drag.ghost.remove();drag=null;window.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',finish);window.removeEventListener('pointercancel',cancel)}
    page.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      const img=e.target.closest('img');
      if(!img||(!tray.contains(img)&&!scene.contains(img))||drag)return;
      if(e.button!==0)return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const ghost=img.cloneNode(true);
      ghost.className='kp-demo-drag-ghost';
      ghost.removeAttribute('style');
      ghost.style.left=e.clientX+'px';
      ghost.style.top=e.clientY+'px';
      document.body.appendChild(ghost);
      drag={pointerId:e.pointerId,ghost,original:img,placed:scene.contains(img)?img:null};
      window.addEventListener('pointermove',move,{passive:false});
      window.addEventListener('pointerup',finish);
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel',cancel);
    });
  });
})();
</script></body></html>
